**Verdict: BLOCKED.** One check the assignment requires, the re-assessment of threat-model residual 7, could not be completed. The rest of the review passed. You also need to restore a host kernel setting (see "Needs your attention" below).

The candidate is confirmed. The current commit (`9c9d086`) only adds files that are excluded from the candidate on top of the frozen commit `f84eed4`, and the candidate ID recomputes to `sha256:34b06b8a…af314e` from both.

**Checks that passed**
- **Tests:** all 90 Node tests and all 22 Python tests pass in a fresh throwaway copy of the candidate.
- **Pre-freeze:** `prefreeze.sh DG0` passes all 11 checks, and the working-tree candidate equals the frozen one.
- **Pipeline check:** passes.
- **Secrets:** no credential patterns in tracked files.
- **CI workflow:** read-only permissions, actions pinned by commit, full git history fetched, and a failed gate check fails the job.
- **Change since round 16:** I reviewed the new copy-back logic in `agent_sandbox.py` and the validator's new rule that requires the private IPC namespace.
- **Before/after reproduction:** I ran the same test cases against both the round-16 and round-17 sandbox code. The script and log are in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-17/`.

**My earlier findings**
- **F-DG0-148 is closed as verified.** Each run now gets its own IPC namespace: the old code shared the host's, the new code has a private one. Nested sandboxing (bubblewrap) still works.
- **The D-031 copy-back fix holds.** When another reviewer saves its record during the run, the old code exited 3 with a false "discarded" report; the new code exits 0. Scope checks still work: rewriting an old record, forging another role's file, symlinks and top-level writes are all still discarded.
- **F-DG0-147 is accepted as an observation.** It still reproduces, but it can't be used to pass a gate.
- **F-DG0-149 stays OPEN.** A safety classifier stopped my analysis of whether residual 7 is really limited to "availability / host-tunable" risk. I did not continue it, so I can't confirm the residual is no larger than the threat model says. It needs a fresh assessment with a person supervising.

**New findings (both Low, not mandatory violations, owner delivery-orchestrator)**
- **F-DG0-150:** a regression in the new copy-back (`agent_sandbox.py:259-268`). If a file with the same name appears in the real directory during the run, `finish()` crashes with an unhandled `FileExistsError`. It exits 1 without writing `sandbox.json`, and files it already processed may have been copied back. The old code discarded the file cleanly. It still fails safe: the runner exits 73 without committing, and the validator requires `sandbox.json`. This only happens if two runs of the same role overlap.
- **F-DG0-151:** the module description at `agent_sandbox.py:23-25` says the PID namespace is private. It isn't; runs share the host's. The code, the threat model and `sandbox.json` all state this correctly.

**Needs your attention:** the host's `/proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern` still reads `test`. The round-16 reproduction left that value, and it has never been restored. I only read it this round and changed nothing. Restoring it is your call.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG0/round-17/`:
- `code-security-reviewer.json` (the review record; it validates against the schema)
- `code-security-reviewer.findings.json`
- `code-security-reviewer.verifications.json`
